statement: If $A$, $B$ and $C$ are the angles of a triangle, show that $\tan A+\tan B+\tan C=\tan A\tan B\tan C$.
solution: Since $A+B+C=\pi$, we have $A+B=\pi-C$, so $\tan(A+B)=-\tan C$. Using the addition formula, $\frac{\tan A+\tan B}{1-\tan A\tan B}=-\tan C$. Cross-multiplying gives $\tan A+\tan B=-\tan C+\tan A\tan B\tan C$, hence $\tan A+\tan B+\tan C=\tan A\tan B\tan C$.
hints: Use A+B = pi - C so tan(A+B) = -tan C.
